purpose: Base-only feasibility gate for a newly generated exact-oracle state-transition task. This does not train a model and cannot establish a policy gain or model capability.
hypothesis: The cached Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct policy can produce exact, authorized multi-call plans on a fresh deterministic ticket-management environment at a nontrivial but improvable base success rate under a CPU-only budget.

families.assign_then_progress: Assign an unassigned ticket, then move it to in_progress; the status transition requires an assignee.
families.verify_then_resolve: Add a missing verified tag, then resolve the ticket; resolution requires the verified tag.
families.resolve_then_archive: Resolve one ticket, then archive it; archiving before resolution is invalid.
families.two_assign_then_progress: For each of two tickets, assign it before moving it to in_progress; the two per-ticket chains must each preserve their own order.

task.composition: 12 tasks per family; each task starts from five tickets. The first three families require two calls each; the two-ticket family requires four calls. One greedy response per task; no resampling.
transition_invariants: Only listed ticket IDs may be mutated.
An unassigned ticket can only be assigned; it cannot enter in_progress until assigned.
Status can advance open -> in_progress or resolved, and in_progress -> resolved; resolved is terminal.
A ticket can be resolved only when it has the verified tag.
archive_ticket requires resolved status and an unarchived ticket.
No unrequested calls, duplicate calls, extra fields, or mutations are authorized.
task.primary_metric: Exact final ticket-state match after executing the returned tool-call array in order.
task.data_boundary: All 48 generated prompts and responses are consumed by this development feasibility screen and permanently excluded from any later training, model selection, development, or confirmation cohort. Any later learner study must use a new protocol and fresh task seed(s).
task.excluded_prior_work: Do not reuse prior TinyLlama tool prompts, Qwen2.5-0.5B update-smoke arithmetic prompts, or any HH, BoolQ, GSM8K, SNLI, generated arithmetic, or code-repair rows. This screen has a new ticket state machine and seed.
task.claim_boundary: A pass only licenses a separate update/save/reload cost smoke. This synthetic environment is not an external benchmark, real user task, policy-improvement result, or general capability measure.

decision_rules.otherwise: Retire this exact model/task/prompt contract. Do not resample, change task family, alter prompts, or tune gates on these outputs. Record the base-only result and keep any learner/confirmation cohort unopened.
decision_rules.interpretation: This is a coarse viability screen, not a statistical efficacy test; report exact counts and the Wilson 95% interval without claiming significance or generalization.
